sentences.text: (b) Award cost of proceedings to the humble petitioner.'

4. Mr. Pathak, who appears for the respondent no. 1 states that the application filed by the petitioner is barred by time as Section 28-A contemplates such an application need to be filed within three months.
Having noted the said submission, the fact of the matter is that the petitioner having made an application, the same need to be decided by the Land Acquisition Commissioner.

5. We dispose of the writ petition by directing the respondent no.1 to consider the application dated 09.06.2022 of the petitioner and pass order in accordance with law within a period of 8 weeks from today.
6. Suffice to state that we have not expressed ourselves on the plea of Mr. Pathak.
The petition stands disposed of.
